why: No major reviewer or authority appears. The results are niche spec calculators and affiliate listicles, mostly ranking for two nights during power outages. Their runtime claims disagree: the same 768 Wh unit is listed at about 2 nights on some pages and 7 or more on others. Only Willrun and one affiliate listicle address a week of camping, and neither shows testing. A focused page with measured AirSense 11 draw, a clear humidifier answer and current prices would stand out.
